name: AWS Neuron Inf2: bert-large-uncased fp32, inf2.xlarge, batch 4, throughput-optimized
methodology: VENDOR MEASURED (AWS NeuronPerf, Neuron SDK 2.21.0). inf2.xlarge, bert-large-uncased FP32 autocast Matmult-BF16, seq 128, batch 4, data-parallel, 'Batch' application. Latency P50 8.41 ms / P99 8.85 ms.
